text: Good catch. Today the phone's own records already say made (bet or bid), how (manual or auto) and which scanner, but the GitHub engine's orders live in a separate file with no 'origin' column, so the engine datasets can't cleanly separate engine-auto, phone-auto, bids and your manual bets. Written up as TCL69: one bets dataset with an origin column (manual / phone-auto / phone-bid / engine-auto / engine-bid / live) built on GitHub, every study and digest table splitting by it, and a rule that your manual bets are reported beside but never counted as evidence for the auto-bet rules. The next Claude account (which takes over the chat at 7:20pm ET) will build it; it's in the repo.
